mike_s: Heads up — hit a repeatable case where continuous-batcher builds a giant queued backlog and we don't recover cleanly. Thinking we should add a queue-level circuit breaker + an eviction handshake between enqueuer and scheduler.
julia: repro?
mike_s: Short: tenant-heavy burst -> queue length spikes -> scheduler keeps trying to pack, headroom calc never triggers eviction until it's too late. Seen timeouts and big p99s.
priya: Can you paste a short excerpt of the logs where headroom stays positive but latency climbs?
mike_s: ```
[2024-05-21T15:12:34Z] tenant=X enqueue len=230 headroom=42 inflight=6 q95_ms=210
[2024-05-21T15:12:35Z] tenant=X enqueue len=270 headroom=40 inflight=7 q95_ms=270
[2024-05-21T15:12:37Z] tenant=X enqueue len=320 headroom=38 inflight=8 q95_ms=430
```
andrew: ok, so headroom metric is not reflecting transient KV cache pressure + kernel stalls. We need a fast signal.
priya: Suggest a "queued_time_ms_95" kicker and a simple circuit-breaker triple: (queued95 > T) && (queue_len > L) && (no recent eviction). Trip -> reject or downgrade to fastpath.
julia: downgrade to fastpath is nice but we need an API between scheduler and enqueuer: currently enqueuer only gets simple ACCEPT/REJECT. We should add a RECOMMEND_ACTION with reason tags: e.g., "evict", "downgrade", "soft-reject".
mike_s: Example proposal snippet: ```json
{"action":"soft-reject","until":"15s","reason":"queue_circuit_tripped","metrics":{"queued95":430,"queue_len":320}}
```
priya: +1 but make the handshake idempotent and include a nonce so enqueuer can ack and track retries.
andrew: Also need hysteresis: multiplier on thresholds for re-enable. Otherwise we thrash. e.g., re-enable when queued95 < 0.6*T for 30s.
julia: We should avoid hard rejects for PLG tier. Make default behavior: try fastpath (no KV cache) for N requests, then soft-reject. Configurable per-tenant.
mike_s: Telemetry: add counter for circuit_trips, time_in_tripped_state, action_outcome (fastpath_success, fastpath_miss, rejected). That will help tune thresholds.
ops-bot: FYI: feature flag "queue-circuit-breaker" created in featureflags/service (deploy: canary) :eyes:
priya: Edge-case: what if fastpath increases CPU so scheduler gets CPU-starved and batch packing worsens? We need a scoring function that estimates net effect. Could incorporate a cost_estimate = cpu_penalty - latency_gain. If cost_estimate > 0 then prefer eviction not fastpath.
andrew: True — scoring gets tricky. For MVP keep it simple: prefer fastpath for short windows (N=10 reqs) and fall back to soft-reject.
julia: On API shape: enqueuer should accept a JSON blob from scheduler with fields: action, nonce, until, allowed_fastpath_tokens, reason_tags. Keep it minimal.
mike_s: Work items: 1) prototype local simulator (stressor + batcher) to validate thresholds 2) add telemetry and dashboard 3) RFC for API + feature flag rollout 4) small enqueuer impl + canary.
priya: I'll take the simulator and telemetry.
andrew: I'll draft the RFC + scoring doc.
julia: I'll own enqueuer changes and canary plan.
mike_s: Awesome. Can we target a spike PR next week?
priya: yes, will open draft by Thu.
ops-bot: @julia assigned to ticket #INF-4023, @priya assigned to #INF-4024, @andrew assigned to #INF-4025
mike_s: One more thing — let's add a short-term mitigation: lower pack_size for heavy-tenants via dynamic config until circuit-breaker lands. Less risky.
julia: Agree. I'll flip pack_size override for tenant-X for now.
priya: Notes for RFC: include failure modes, a simple math derivation for thresholds, and example logs + dashboard panels.
andrew: Also list safety rules: never hard-reject enterprise tier unless explicit admin toggle.
mike_s: Cool. Thanks all. We'll sync in eng-runtime tomorrow 10am for quick demo of simulator.
